title: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
summary: Hugging Face 的 Open ASR Leaderboard 首次加入全球南方语言，旨在推动低资源语言的语音识别技术发展，并鼓励社区贡献更多非英语数据。
highlights: The Open ASR Leaderboard now includes its first Global South language, marking a step toward more inclusive speech technology.
This addition aims to address the underrepresentation of low-resource languages in automatic speech recognition benchmarks.
The community is encouraged to contribute datasets and models to further expand language coverage.
